verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component that does not store or manage user data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the processor itself ships such a capability; mentions of hardware-level security and local AI execution do not count as user-facing retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
